parameters.name: CloudAssetQueryData
parameters.description: Query data list based on keywords.

parameters.name: CloudAssetTypes
parameters.description: The details of the cloud asset.

parameters.name: Criteria
parameters.description:
The search conditions for assets. The value of this parameter is in the JSON format and contains the following fields:

*   **name**: the name of the search condition.

*   **value**: the value of the search condition.

*   **logicalExp**: the logical relation for multiple search conditions. Valid values:

    *   **OR**: The search conditions use a logical **OR**.
    *   **AND**: The search conditions use a logical **AND**.

> You can call the [GetCloudAssetCriteria](~~GetCloudAssetCriteria~~) operation to query supported search conditions.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: LogicalExp
parameters.description:
The logical relation for multiple search conditions. Valid values:

*   **OR**: The search conditions use a logical **OR**.
*   **AND**: The search conditions use a logical **AND**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-cloud-asset-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --criteria name_:_internetIp_,_value_:_192.168_,_logicalExp_:_OR --logical-exp OR --page-size 20 --current-page 2 --cloud-asset-types AssetType=18 Vendor=0 AssetSubType=0 --cloud-asset-query-data Operator=INCLUDE Data=163.8.8.9 --is-sale-data true --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ListCloudAssetInstances --region cn-hangzhou --CloudAssetQueryData.1.Operator INCLUDE --CloudAssetQueryData.1.Data '163.8.8.9' --IsSaleData true --PageSize 20 --CloudAssetTypes.1.Vendor 0 --CurrentPage 2 --CloudAssetTypes.1.AssetType 18 --CloudAssetTypes.1.AssetSubType 0 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Criteria 'name_:_internetIp_,_value_:_192.168_,_logicalExp_:_OR' --LogicalExp OR
